messages:
taylor: Heads-up: deploying runtime v2.8 today at 16:00 PST. Release includes observability updates (new dashboard panels, trace sampling bump for long tails, alert threshold tweaks). Owning: @owen. Plan: canary -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~30m. Please stand by for smoke checks. :rocket:

owen: Got it. I’ll kick off the canary at 16:00 and post links. Preflight: qcache warmup ✅, unit smoke locally ✅.

sasha: Oncall here — I’ll watch infra alerts and page if we see 5xx or sustained latency. Request: mark anyone who should mute noisy alerts during promotion. :eyes: 

taylor: @jess-obsv please note we want a temporary alert tuning for model-failures during the rollout to avoid noisy flaps. I'll paste the proposed rule below.

jess-obsv: I’ll update dashboard and alert rules. Changes I’m planning: add kv-cache-hit-rate panel, add generation tail-latency (p99/p99.9), increase trace sampling for >1s requests to 25%, and set a short-lived alert escalation window. I’ll annotate the dash with rollback signals.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1712346805. Canary ID: canary-20240403-42. Link: https://deploys.redwood/canary-20240403-42

taylor: Smoke checklist (quick):
- healthcheck: GET /v1/health -> 200
- sanity generation: small prompt -> coherent response < 500ms median
- embeddings sanity: vector size correct + non-empty
- observe tokens/sec and qcache hit-rate for regressions
- run 3 sample traces and confirm kv cache hit tags

Use this quick curl for sanity generation:
```bash
curl -sS -X POST "https://api.redwood/v1/generate" \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-runtime-v2","input":"summarize: hello world"}'
```

sasha: Early canary metrics: p50/p95 fine, p99 ticked up to ~450ms for long requests, no increase in 5xx so far. Watching.

jess-obsv: Pushed alert adjustments (temporary):
```yaml
alert: model-inference-errors
window: 2m
threshold: error_rate >= 0.08
action: page-on-call
notes: temporary increase for rollout; auto-revert in 2h if stable
```
This should reduce pages for small transient blips but still catch real regressions.

owen: Promoting to 20% now. Will monitor traces and qcache metrics for the next 10m.

deploy-bot: Promotion started at 1712346910. Rollout step: 20% - ETA ~10m.

taylor: Rollback criteria (handy):
- sustained 5xx > 2% over 5m or
- error_rate spike affecting >= 30% of requests in a region or
- p99 generation latency > 1.5s sustained for 5m
Rollback command: `deploy rollback --id canary-20240403-42`

sasha: Added tracing tag `canary:v2.8` so we can filter traces quickly. If you see a flood of errors tag the trace with `rollback` in notes.

jess-obsv: Dash link with annotations: https://dash.redwood/runtime-v2.8?from=now-1h To check: kv-cache-hit-rate, gen p99/p99.9, error-rate by model. I scheduled auto-revert of the temporary alert change at 18:00 unless I manually extend.

owen: Full rollout complete at 1712347040. No rollback required. Thanks everyone for the quick checks. :tada: 

deploy-bot: Rollout finished at 1712347040. Deployed runtime v2.8 to production (release-id: release-20240403-7)
